bullets.text: Destination Era targets multi-product 'Robinsons', representing >40% of auto premium where PGR holds <1% share versus ~9% total auto share; bundling seeks to maximize policy life extension and customer retention.

Full-year CR 92.3 beat 96 target; pretax underwriting income $1.4B; net income $2.15/share (+11% YOY); comprehensive income $2.27/share (+10% YOY); ROE exceeded 19% on net income and 20% on comprehensive income.

Agreed to acquire ~two-thirds of ARX (ASI parent) for ~$875M; $404M variable dividend ($0.69/share); 11.1M shares repurchased for $271M; $19B portfolio returned 4.5%; debt-to-capital ended at 23.8%; issued $350M debt.

Written premiums reached $18.7B, continuing multi-year billion-dollar milestone gains toward an envisioned $20B threshold with no implied timing; Special Lines and Commercial Lines contributed disproportionately to target margin outperformance.

Direct sold a record 2M+ policies with strong incremental cost per sale and improved policy life extension; Agency auto policyholders fell 2%, prompting modifications in product design, underwriting, and ease-of-use.

Expense ratio ended at 20% and LAE reached approximately 10%, levels envisioned 20-plus years ago; opened 6 Service Centers (67 total, majority co-located with claims offices), seeing about 25% of nationwide repairable vehicles.

Snapshot reached 12B+ recorded driving miles and 2.5M participants; Big Data analytics expanded into media analysis and fraud detection; Keynote ranked Progressive's website #1 in the insurance industry for tenth straight year.

Entered Massachusetts Agency auto market, achieving 50-state coverage across both Agency and Direct channels; introduced renters insurance product; testing point-of-sale Snapshot discount advance to improve Agency adoption.

Superstore ad campaign debuted its 100th commercial starring Flo; LeBron James Halloween costume swap generated 300M+ social media views; marketing expenditures generated new high watermark prospect volumes at strong cost efficiency.

The 2014 rating environment, not easily summarized except at state and coverage levels, was about 3–4% for Progressive, which was not inconsistent with other sources of consumer inflation or wage growth.
